## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue if there is one.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and any untested behavior. Use synthetic request/response examples when helpful.

## Compatibility and risk

Describe changes to tool inputs, configuration, provider calls, cost, cleanup or security boundaries. Write "None" if there are no such changes.

- [ ] Tests or documentation cover the change where needed.
- [ ] No credentials, private payloads or live sandbox tokens are included.
- [ ] Known limitations are stated accurately.
